resolvedStack: Electron + Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma
name: SoundCraft Studio Console
description: SoundCraft Studio Console is an Electron desktop audio mastering and session asset manager for managing multi-track stems, DSP plugin preset chains, and batch export render queues.

metadata.name: SoundCraft Studio Console
metadata.description: Electron desktop mastering console for audio sessions, DSP presets, and export queues.

files.description: Electron, Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, Zod, lucide-react, react-icons.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, ExportStatus, TrackFormat enums and User, AudioSession, DspPreset, ExportJob models.
Shared TypeScript types for AudioSession, DspPreset, ExportJob.
Tailwind CSS directives for dark audio studio console.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Desktop landing page for SoundCraft Studio Console.
Desktop workspace switching between SessionBrowser, PresetRack, and RenderQueue.
Client renderer component listing audio sessions fetched from /api/sessions.
Client renderer component managing DSP plugin presets from /api/presets.
Client renderer component showing batch export jobs and progress badges.
Client hook fetching /api/sessions on mount via useEffect.
GET and POST API route for AudioSession records.
GET and POST API route for DspPreset records.
